title: Prandtl bearing capacity, fully specified Prandtl surface (reference values)

meta.title: Prandtl bearing capacity, fully specified Prandtl surface (reference values)
meta.notes: Prandtl bearing capacity as a commercial program specifies it: weightless c = 20 kPa soil, 102.83 kPa over 10 m, the fully specified Prandtl surface (active wedge, 90° fan about the load edge, passive wedge).

source.reference: Prandtl (1920). Über die Härte plastischer Körper. Nachr. Ges. Wiss. Göttingen, Math.-phys. Kl., 74–85.
source.derived_from: cSlope verification problem V078 (MIT License), https://github.com/ZilanCiftci/cslope
notes: Strip load 102.83 kPa = c(π + 2) over 10 m; the domain size is not given in the manual (irrelevant for a weightless soil on a fixed surface).

Surface: active wedge under the load (apex at x = 5, 5 m deep), fan centered on the load's right edge (R = 7.071 m), passive wedge to x = 20 — the mechanism drawn in Fig. 49. commercial program B Janbu (uncorrected) 0.895; entry-exit search: Bishop 1.056, Janbu 1.031, M-P 1.08. Theory 1.0.
commercial program B Bishop 0.924 is not checked: Bishop on a non-circular surface depends on the moment axis (cSlope 0.909).
cSlope fija options.tolerance = 0.001 (tolerancia del solver) en sus checks; no se importa: ogs usa analysis.tolerance = 1e-05.
